svg.title: Compare unit-bearing map scale with unitless 1 to 180
svg.desc: An original scale conversion: one drawing inch represents fifteen actual feet, and fifteen feet equals 180 actual inches, so the unitless scale factor is 1 to 180. A six-foot wall is 72 actual inches and becomes 0.4 drawing inches. The two reference line segments use the same diagram scale, 120 pixels per drawing inch: one inch is 120 pixels and the measured 0.4 inch wall segment is 48 pixels. The actual wall is not drawn at paper scale; only the wall representation is.
svg.text: Both drawn segments share one diagram unit; the real wall is only represented.
